ranked.lab_protocol: Desk rule, no replay. The pseudo-private bootstrap is dropped because it is degenerate (P(D<0) = 0 for every component). Inputs: the scored public value of every candidate file (kaggle CLI), plus these priors: lab-to-LB slope k ~0 for rules that trust the in-sample network (measured on ef, ef_a0, relink-off, DivNet veto) and ~0.3 for network-free rules; sigma floor = max(0.3 x |lab delta|, 0.0011 public one-change sd, 0.0004 rounding). PRE-REGISTERED RULES: (1) Every final is an already-scored submission of the exact file. Never pick the max-public of near-copies of one bundle (winner's curse ~+0.0013 at k=3). (2) F1 = the highest-scoring 'public-proven' file: B + float(safe), where B = exp51 if P31 >= 0.951, exp48 if P31 < 0.948, and in the 0.949-0.950 zone the higher of the two float versions. Riders (fork-midpoint, overlap splice, retrained head) move into F1 only through a scored file F1' whose public >= F1 public. (3) F2 = F1 + edge filter ef_a3_rl_pr + stitch st_all (see ef-anomaly-attribution-finals), eligible if its public >= F1 - 0.003. Its E[D+] = mu*Phi(mu/s) + s*phi(mu/s) with mu ~0 (public showed 0) and s >= 0.0048 gives ~+0.0019, against +0.0002 for a near-copy. (4) Fallback F2 if the hedge probe fails the floor: the other base (coordhead toggled), already scored. (5) Apply the J-vs-multiplier screen to every final component. Coordhead enters BOTH finals only if P31 >= 0.951, because a public score on an unseen embryo is itself the transfer test; otherwise it goes in one final only. (6) Tick both finals manually by 29 Sep 20:00 UTC and re-read the submissions page. If nothing is ticked, Kaggle auto-picks the two best public submissions, which are near-copies.

ranked.lab_protocol: STEP A, GT-free registration (Kaggle CPU lab, ~30 min, 4 processes; runs today). Exact-content anchor hashing on all 199 train zarrs: anchors = voxels equal to their 3x7x7 max filter and above the frame p99.5, hashed on the raw 3x5x5 uint16 patch; each offset collects votes. A pair is accepted with >= 30 votes, >= 99.9% exact voxel equality on 3 overlap frames, >= 5 overlapping frames and >= 5% spatial overlap. GATE A: >= 60 of the 65 GT-linked 44b6 pairs at the exact GT offset (+-1 voxel); 0 accepted 6bba pairs (the 1-frame boundary overlaps must be rejected); 0 cross-prefix pairs. STEP B0, structure bit-probe (needs the user's explicit OK after a check of the rules page): one submission whose kernel runs ONLY the registration on the hidden test zarrs (~15 min). It raises RuntimeError if >= 1 pair is accepted, and otherwise writes a valid trivial CSV (weak score). An error means at least one hidden embryo has overlapping crops, so build Step B. A valid score closes the line at zero engineering cost. STEP B (only if B0 errors): the splice, replayed on e48 tails, all 199 videos. PRE-REGISTERED GATE: 44b6 per-embryo delta >= +0.002; sign test over leak groups, >= 7 of the non-zero groups positive; the result without leak group 0 >= 0 (group 0 holds 75% of the simulated gain); 6bba bit-identical; 44b6 node ratio change <= +0.3%; division TP/FP unchanged; churn (components replaced where both copies were TP) reported. Expected versus simulated ceiling: +89 FN units and +41 FP units, i.e. +0.006 on the embryo. LB: F1' = F1 + splice. Adopt if public >= F1 public (it is an exact no-op on a 6bba-type public embryo).
ranked.implementation_sketch: One standalone last notebook cell behind flag OVERLAP_SPLICE, wrapped in try/except that restores the untouched CSV. (1) Registration: re-read the test zarrs (~8 min); anchors via torch max_pool3d (3,7,7) on the GPU; blake2b 8-byte hash of the 3x5x5 patch; skip hash buckets with more than 10 entries; vote mode; then the equality check (this also handles frozen frames at dt +-1). Do not depend on filename prefixes; log prefix hits only. (2) Splice per accepted pair, working on submission.csv graphs. Map B into A's frame. Hungarian correspondence within 3.5 um (at 2.5 um, 11% of doubly-correct nodes would churn). A node agrees at track level when it is corresponded and its successor maps through the correspondence. Non-agree nodes are grouped into components by both copies' edges plus same-frame proximity <= 7 um. Owner = larger mean min(spatial border distance um, 1 um x frames to clip end), and B takes over a component only if the owner gap is >= 3 AND the non-owner score is < 8. That keeps +78 of the simulated +89 and removes the coin-flip zone. Replace A's nodes and edges with B's, rewiring seams only through agree nodes. Skip components that contain a fork parent or child, and skip 3-copy cases (36 edges). Drop new fragments shorter than 3 nodes. Revert a video whose node count rises by more than 0.5%. Also reuse the scratch scripts oc_hash.py, oc_sim.py and oc_fp_sim.py; the lab replays the same function on per-video tails. DEBUG flag: run on the known overlapping train pair 44b6_12dfb391 / 44b6_3a861e03 (offset -86,6,-114,75) through the cell-12 TEST_DIR swap.
ranked.expected_public_gain: Unconditional ~+0.0005 (range 0 to +0.002). It is 0 if the public embryo is tiled like 6bba. If the public embryo is 44b6-type with ~35 clips (half the train density), about +0.001 to +0.002. Private is similar and could be larger if a private embryo matches train crop density (ceiling +0.006 per embryo).
ranked.probability: P(the hidden test has overlapping crops) ~0.5. P(the lab gate passes | overlap) ~0.6. P(a visible public change) ~0.15-0.2.
ranked.effort_hours: Step A + bit-probe 4-5 h. Full splice + lab 1-1.5 days. 10-20 min extra kernel runtime. 1-2 LB slots.
ranked.main_risk: (1) Rules and spirit: this is transductive use of the hidden test clips plus an error-based structure probe, so the user must approve after reading the rules. (4) Gains below 0.0005 are invisible at 3-decimal LB resolution.

PRE-REGISTERED PASS (FM45_sd): (1) 0 division TP lost on each embryo; (2) division FP down by >= 4 in total (exp39 audit: 6 at 4.5 um); (3) adjusted-edge delta >= -0.0001 per embryo and edge TP loss <= 2; (4) node count identical and inserted-fork counts identical to e48; (5) public-calibrated objective 1.36*dTP - 0.36*dFP_eval > 0. ranked.implementation_sketch: --patch forkmid: forkmid_final_graph(nodes_by_id, edges, stats, FORKMID_PARAMS) called as the LAST graph edit, after divinsert and after linefit (it sees the shipped coordinates). For each parent P with exactly 2 children at t+1 whose added child edge is a safe-division edge (safe_division==1 in the kernel, or edge_prob None/NaN and NOT div_inserted in the replay), compute mid = |P - (c1+c2)/2| in um (scale 1.625/0.40625/0.40625). If mid >= 4.5, drop the safe-division edge. Side rule: drop the ILP-side edge instead when that edge is an unscored relink edge (finite edge_prob <= 0). Nodes are never touched and the short-track filter is not re-run (a node-count change is what flips min-track-length on the LB). Knobs BIOHUB_FORKMID_{ENABLE,MID_UM,SCOPE}; ENABLE=0 is an exact no-op. Replay key fm.*, same function text. Stats: forkmid_checked / dropped / dropped_ilp_side.

ranked.lab_protocol: Reduced to the one residual all three skeptics allowed: a PLAIN de-quantiser retrain of the V1284 head. The gate-aware loss, 3 um z cap, track-identity pairs and 27-point stencil are dropped (tail offsets are unlearnable, |r| <= 0.09). CONDITIONS TO START: P31 >= 0.951 AND the zero-mode control P35 (exp51 with COORDHEAD_MODE=zero: float coords + trilinear gather, no shift) scores >= 0.002 below exp51, i.e. the shift itself carries the gain. PILOT (26 Sep, after the GPU quota reset): one Kaggle 2xT4 kernel, COORDHEAD_MODE=capture plus a new short-circuit that stops each video after refine(), on 36 train videos (24 tail-rich 6bba + 12 44b6, one per leak group). Keep peaks Hungarian-matched to GT within 4 um plus a 3% sample; save fp16 224-d features (~1.3 GPU h, < 1 GB). CPU training (Kaggle CPU kernel): 224-32-3 MLP, SiLU, zero-init last layer, bounded output 2*d/(1+|d|) (<= 2 um), Huber loss on (GT - peak) in um for pairs < 4 um, per-embryo mean offset subtracted from the targets. Folds: embryo-held-out (6bba -> 44b6 and the reverse) plus GroupKFold by leak group. Compare against the public head on the same features. KILL unless ALL hold on BOTH held-out embryos: the < 4 um share improves by >= +0.005 over the public head; the 4-7 um zone count drops by >= 3% relative to the public head; the per-embryo mean shift stays within +-0.2 um of the public head's. PASS -> train on all captured pairs and ship the new state_dict/mean/scale as a drop-in head file. LB: one probe, F1 with the new head vs F1. Adopt if public >= F1 + 0.001. With floats on in both arms.
